integrity: The published facet count, h-star polynomial, and general triangle criterion are credited to prior literature. The four-family face classification and full ordinary face generating polynomial are the sole novel mathematical claims under review.
scientific_limitations: Exact proof is for every integer p,q>=2 and the unweighted real symmetric-edge polytope of K_{p,q}; numerical hull enumeration is finite corroboration, not an infinite proof. Full source priority is provisional, and independent mathematical audit has not occurred.
title: Four-family face classification and complete face polynomial of bipartite symmetric edge polytopes
